10-08-1871 is October 8, 1871.  
Add 262 days:  
October has 31 days → remaining days in October = 31 - 8 = 23 → 262 - 23 = 239 left.  
November 30 days → 239 - 30 = 209.  
December 31 days → 209 - 31 = 178.  
1872 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception) → February has 29 days.  
January 31 → 178 - 31 = 147.  
February 29 → 147 - 29 = 118.  
March 31 → 118 - 31 = 87.  
April 30 → 87 - 30 = 57.  
May 31 → 57 - 31 = 26.  
June has 30 days → 26 days into June = June 26.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1872-06-26
